Looking over the eisenruck and inspecting its finer details, you realize that it will always need to be "a/n (whatever)/(whatever)/eisenruck", so the item's article and adjective CAN be changed, but "eisenruck" cannot.
To insert a gem into the eisenruck, you must be wearing the eisenruck and holding a gem in one hand, then PUSH eisenruck.
Note 1:  The eisenruck must be worn continuously for a minimum of one day before any of its gem-eating abilities will function.
Note 2:  When you LOOK at your eisenruck, if a socket is described as "open," then it is ready to have a gem inserted into it.  If a socket is described as "closed," then it is in cooldown.

Please keep that in mind if you request an alteration for this item.  The "damaged" description texts may also need to be changed by the merchant in order to reflect the changes of your alteration.

Welcome to the Small Diner's Board from the shop All Fingers and No Crumbs found in Evermore Hollow.

This is a Host Board, which means that you can create a culinary masterpiece to share with your guests by adding food items to the board by placing the items on it.  Once you have arranged your meal, simply PULL the board and it will create a complete copy of your meal for your guests to share.  If you are displeased with the meal that you have arranged, then CLEAN the board.  Be cautious as cleaning the board will destroy all food on it.
This board is Tier 3 of 3.
At this Tier, you can do the following:
PULL the board - Create a copy of your meal for up to 8 guests.
TURN the board - Change the type of board you will serve to your guests.  Type options are: Plain, Tea Board, Drink Sampler Board, or Blind Drink Sampler Board
SPIN the board - When you are ready to eat, you choose an eating style with spin.  Style Options are: Plain, Ham-Handed, Fussy, or Dainty
PLACE (food item) on the board - You are able to add 9 food items to the board.
These options are available for your Guest Boards as well.

Analysis of an intricate silver toothkey set with a mother-of-pearl handle indicates the creator has provided the following information:
-- Tooth Extracter --
This silver toothkey is an instrument designed to extract teeth from certain dead creatures.
If unlocked, player teeth can also be extracted once a day (with consent).
Extracted teeth/fangs can be used in the Weaving system.
==Alteration Guidelines==
* The 15/15/15, long, and show of this silver toothkey can be freely altered as long as they follow all guidelines.
* The only approved nouns for this toothkey are "pelican" or "toothkey".

* These instruments include a hooked "claw" that slips around the tooth, a "bolster" that rests against the opposite side of the tooth as a fulcrum, and a handle that is usually ring-shaped.  The Elanthian versions additionally include a small crank to tighten the claw against the bolster.
* The claw should be made of metal and can have a custom material and custom descriptor.
* The handle can be made of anything hard (metal, wood, bone, porcelain, mother-of-pearl, etc.) and can have a custom material and a custom descriptor.
* Any merchant comfortable with this script can change the custom settings, but these should generally be changed to match the alteration.
==Features==
* Extract Weaveable Creature Teeth/Fangs
POINT the silver toothkey at an appropriate dead creature, TURN to select the tooth you want, and then PULL to extract the tooth.
POINT the silver toothkey with no target to clear the selection.
Each creature extraction gives you a bundle of 2 teeth that can be used in the Weaving system.  Each creature can only be extracted from once.
Different creatures will have different-looking teeth.  Possible types of teeth: tooth, canine tooth (or fang), incisor, molar (or carnassial).  Not all creatures have all types.
The adjective of the created tooth will be the creature's name, but you can toggle this appearing by using PUSH on the silver toothkey.
* Extract Player Teeth [Unlocked]
Once a day you can extract a Weaveable tooth from a player using the same method as is used for creatures.
The player must be alive and must give CONSENT.  This action will injure and stun them.
This will give you only a single tooth.
* Fluff Actions [Tier 2 of 2]

Extra fluff actions let you perform examinations on player or creature teeth so you are better able to diagnose any potential dental issues.  Rooting around in a player's mouth, even without extracting a tooth, requires CONSENT.
At this tier, your silver toothkey captures:

POINT (targeted - select a player/creature to examine), POINT (untargeted - clear any current selection), TURN (switch to a different tooth type of the current target), PUSH (toggle whether adjective appears in created tooth), PULL (extract currently selected tooth), POKE (targeted/untargeted), PINCH (targeted/untargeted), PONDER (targeted/untargeted), CLEAN.
==Current Settings==
* Claw Material: silver
* Claw Descriptor: curved
* Handle Material: mother-of-pearl
* Handle Descriptor: smooth

raw: This stunning nautilus shell ocarina is a genuine nautilus shell, a masterpiece of nature's design.  Its elegantly spiraled form showcases a series of smooth, flowing curves that taper gracefully to a point, embodying the delicate balance of oceanic beauty.  The shell glimmers in a soft light peach hue, reminiscent of sun-kissed coral, with subtle pearlescent undertones that shift gently with movement.  Intricate ridges spiral outward from the center, creating a mesmerizing pattern that draws the eye, while the polished exterior reflects hints of the surrounding landscape like a serene mirror.  Its organic texture and natural sheen evoke the mysteries of the sea, making it not just an instrument but a striking piece of coastal artistry.
The nautilus shell ocarina requires skill in woodwind instruments to play effectively.
The nautilus shell ocarina must be played with two hands.
The ocarina can be worn around the neck.  The ocarina appears to serve some purpose.
It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of gemstone, an extremely common material.
Analysis of a pearlescent nautilus shell ocarina suspended on a clinch knot cord indicates the creator has provided the following information:

Hello, intrepid player!  This nautilus shell ocarina is a prize from the Undergrowth of Biitermere Woods (Ebon Gate).  When worn, it has a chance to summon a Luukosian lanternbearer after you slay a creature.  When the lanternbearer is slain, the ocarina has a 0% chance to grant an attack, defense, or regenerative boon.  Further, it has a 30% chance to generate a phylactery that can be CLENCH'd to either regain 1-3 spirit or extend one of the boons by 30 seconds, with a 1 hour cooldown.
SETTINGS
Attuned : No one
Charges : 0
Dirge of the Lanternbearer : off
Soulbound Crescendo : 0
Illusion Setting : off, Option 1 - Radiating from the spiral-like lines of the nautilus shell ocarina that drapes from his neck, a pale light surrounds Brodega in a pearlescent aura.
VERBS
cover : Toggles the illusion effect on and off.  Currently: off
raise : Toggles Dirge of the Lanternbearer on and off.  Currently: off
turn : Selects the next illusion or you may "turn ocarina to [1-7]" to select a specific one.  Currently: 1
RP verbs : exhale, breathe, gasp, hum, push, whisper, yell
ALTERATIONS
This item may be freely altered, but it must remain an ocarina in both form and function.  It cannot be in a condition where it cannot play music (e.g. must be in good, working condition).
The nautilus shell ocarina will cost 15,000,000 coins.

raw: A faint silver sheen ripples along the standard's fabric at measured intervals, a counterpoint to the pulsing gleam of the runes scribed along the full length of the pole.
You determine that you could wear a sacrosanct grey battle standard with a rippling silver sheen as a battle standard.
Analysis of a sacrosanct grey battle standard with a rippling silver sheen indicates the creator has provided the following information:
This is a tier 3 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.
Attunement:                       Not Attuned
Charges:                          200
Deity:                            No deity
Deity Primary Color:              Grey
Deity Secondary Color:            Silver
Rally [PRAY]:                     Ready
Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH]:       Ready

If the standard's deity conversion ability is not on cooldown, you may visit a shrine honoring a specific deity to convert the standard to that deity.  To do so, simply PRAY standard TO <deity>.  This ability is subject to a 30 day cooldown, and the cooldown is not currently active.
The battle standard can be TUCKed while worn in order to hide it from sight.

This is a flag on a pole, and the description should not conflict with that.  Base, long, and show description can be altered.  Because of the holy and magical nature of this item, the description may include the following words: holy, sacred, consecrated, sacrosanct, and hallowed.

There will always be a reference to the pole and the banner upon LOOKing at this item.  Please take this into account when composing your show description.  The material may be changed to other types of wood at the merchant's discretion.  Allowed nouns: standard, flag, banner, ensign, pennant, pennon, banderole, banderol, bannerol, oriflamme, and gonfalon.  Finally, any and all alterations will be irreversibly removed if the battle standard is ever converted to another deity in the future.
The battle standard may not be lightened.
The battle standard will cost 8,250,000 coins.

Wehnimer's Landing.name: a sacrosanct pure golden battle standard with a rippling black sheen

raw: A faint black sheen ripples along the standard's fabric at measured intervals, a counterpoint to the pulsing gleam of the runes scribed along the full length of the pole.
You determine that you could wear a sacrosanct pure golden battle standard with a rippling black sheen as a battle standard.
Analysis of a sacrosanct pure golden battle standard with a rippling black sheen indicates the creator has provided the following information:
This is a tier 1 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.
Attunement:                       Not Attuned
Charges:                          200
Deity:                            Lorminstra
Deity Primary Color:              Pure golden
Deity Secondary Color:            Black
Rally [PRAY]:                     Ready

If the standard's deity conversion ability is not on cooldown, you may visit a shrine honoring a specific deity to convert the standard to that deity.  To do so, simply PRAY standard TO <deity>.  This ability is subject to a 30 day cooldown, and the cooldown is not currently active.
The battle standard can be TUCKed while worn in order to hide it from sight.

The material may be changed to other types of wood at the merchant's discretion.  Allowed nouns: standard, flag, banner, ensign, pennant, pennon, banderole, banderol, bannerol, oriflamme, and gonfalon.  Finally, any and all alterations will be irreversibly removed if the battle standard is ever converted to another deity in the future.
The battle standard may not be lightened.

Wehnimer's Landing.name: a sacrosanct bright white battle standard with a rippling muted black sheen

raw: A faint muted black sheen ripples along the standard's fabric at measured intervals, a counterpoint to the pulsing gleam of the runes scribed along the full length of the pole.
You determine that you could wear a sacrosanct bright white battle standard with a rippling muted black sheen as a battle standard.
Analysis of a sacrosanct bright white battle standard with a rippling muted black sheen indicates the creator has provided the following information:
This is a tier 3 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.
Attunement:                       Not Attuned
Charges:                          200
Deity:                            Voln
Deity Primary Color:              Bright white

Analysis of a pyrographed ghostwood auction block indicates the creator has provided the following information:
The auction block can be used as a tool and prop for setting up your own auctions and raffles.
The auction block is UNLOCKED to run raffles.
Alteration Guidelines:
The auction block can be altered freely as long as it still reflects being some sort of flat container with an interior and flat upper surface for displaying items for examination.
A gavel is used for messaging which can also be altered, but it must remain a "gavel" and cannot have a long or show.
The two raffle table props, the tickets, and barrel, can also be altered.  However, they, too, must keep the noun "tickets" and "barrel" and cannot have shows or longs.
Usage:
To run an auction: PUT the prize(s) (if desired) on the auction block for your customers to INSPECT and ANALYZE.
PUSH the auction block to toggle between runner-up and non-runner up modes.
BID <amount> block to set the starting bid amount.
POUND the block to begin bidding!
Bidders should BID <amount> block to up their bids.
POKE the block to announce the current bid and progress through once, twice, three times.
POUND the block to end bidding.
The winning bidder will get five minutes to return with a note large enough to cover their bid, after which DROPping it in the block will give them the prize(s) you have placed on top (if any).
To run a raffle, PULL the auction block to place tickets and a raffle barrel on top of the auction block.
PUSH the auction block to toggle between one ticket per customer or multiple tickets allowed.

Wehnimer's Landing.name: a sacrosanct pale golden battle standard with a rippling brown sheen

raw: A faint brown sheen ripples along the standard's fabric at measured intervals, a counterpoint to the pulsing gleam of the runes scribed along the full length of the pole.

Analysis of a sacrosanct pale golden battle standard with a rippling brown sheen indicates the creator has provided the following information:
This is a tier 1 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.
Attunement:                       Not Attuned
Charges:                          200
Deity:                            Eonak
Deity Primary Color:              Pale golden
Deity Secondary Color:            Brown
Rally [PRAY]:                     Ready

If the standard's deity conversion ability is not on cooldown, you may visit a shrine honoring a specific deity to convert the standard to that deity.  To do so, simply PRAY standard TO <deity>.  This ability is subject to a 30 day cooldown, and the cooldown is not currently active.

Analysis of a yierka hide nakaten with linen-wrapped pommel rings indicates the creator has provided the following information:
--------- TIU & QAITEKE LIZARD SADDLES - ANALYZE INFO  ---------
This nakaten is a Tiu & Qaiteke saddle meant for use with "lizard" mounts.
Verb Sets active on this nakaten:
*Verb Set 1:  DROP/PUT, GET, MOUNT (with styles), and DISMOUNT (with styles).
MOUNT styles -- MOUNT {STYLE} {target lizard} -- that are valid for this nakaten's current setup are:  RIGHT, LEFT, JUMP, LEG, CROUCH, BATTLECRY
DISMOUNT styles -- DISMOUNT {STYLE} -- that are valid for this nakaten's current setup are: RIGHT, LEFT, JUMP, SLIDE, LEG, CROUCH, BATTLECRY
--------- ALTERATION INFORMATION ---------

The noun cannot change.  So what can you do?  Any merchant may alter the article, adjective, and/or long description of the nakaten.  They can also add a show description that will append to the hard-coded LOOK.  All alterations must be in keeping with the saddle's style (see below).  It is also recommended that you avoid show descriptions that rely on the long description for future-forward accessory use that temporarily changes the long description.

Note that some aspects of the LOOK are hard-coded (such as the length of the stirrups) and cannot currently be modified by a merchant.  Currently, the pommel ring is set up as double, which CAN be swapped out (between single and double) by willing merchants.

This saddle's style (which is not currently eligible to be changed to another style) is set to nakaten (Tehir).  For alteration purposes, keep the following in mind:  It has a flat, wide seat, a minimal pommel, and no gullet.  Instead of a horn, it has a "pommel ring(s)" -- either a single upright ring or double outward angled rings that jut out from the pommel area.  It has a high, back-angled cantle with a fantail.  The strap system includes forward and rear girth straps that connect via the legs and front of the chest.  Saddle blanket ("nakatela" in Tehir) use is common, and pads are never used.  It is heavy compared to other saddle styles.
The yierka hide nakaten will cost 2,000,000 coins.

~*~ Illegal Alteration Clothing Line (IACLs) ~*~

This item can have different descriptions when held and worn.  Wait!  What??  That's right, you can now have a tight bodice, low-rise pants, or maybe a long cloak that actually drags on the ground.  Keep in mind that normal alteration rules may still apply based on merchant personalities and general good taste.
Verbs:  ATTEND, REMOVE, RUB and WEAR
Alteration Guidelines:
* You can have a base, long, and show
* Base:  the same for both worn and unworn
* Long:  not required for unworn (unless you want a show) but required for worn
* Show:  not required, but if you have it, it will be the same for worn and unworn, and you will need a long for unworn too
* DISALLOWED:  Anything that references exposed skin is not allowed (so no shoulder-baring shirts or tight pants revealing a toned abdomen, for example)
* Overly Risque Items:  This script is not meant to get around any policies on overly risque items.  The merchant has final say on this.
This item has the following worn description:
an ebon lace corset visibly boned along the contours of the hips
The ebon lace corset will cost 150,000 coins.

raw: An oval cabochon of translucent scarlet bloodstone is set within the pendant.  Thready veins of nacre wend beneath the stone's surface and ripple with a gentle, pulsing rhythm reminiscent of blood flow.
The pendant can be worn around the neck.
It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of gemstone, an extremely common material.
Analysis of an oval bloodstone pendant indicates the creator has provided the following information:
Bloodstone Jewelry
The bloodstone pendant has been infused with the vitality of an Empath and is tier 1 with 100 of 100 charges remaining.
The bloodstone pendant is not currently attuned to anyone.
Tier 1:  Altered State
Grants enhancive attributes of +20 max health, +10 max mana, and +5 max stamina per tier.
Tier 2:  Augmented Recovery
Grants enhancive attributes of +4 health, +2 mana, and +1 stamina recovery per tier.
Tier 3:  Vivacity
Activated ability to regain 20% of health, 10% of stamina, or 5% of mana every 2 seconds for 10 seconds.
- BESEECH pendant (HEALTH / STAMINA / MANA)
Tier 4:  Sanguine Swap
Store all existing wounds into the jewelry for 10 minutes, after which the wounds will automatically reappear.
- SPIN:  Initiate the transfer of wounds for a second time to transfer the wounds back early.
Tier 5:  Sanguine Sacrifice
Attacks deal an additional amount of concussion damage, occasionally overflowing to cause Major Bleed.
- PROD: Disable the additional messaging for concussion damage.
- PINCH: Toggle whether to enable the overflow capability.
The bloodstone pendant can be TUCKed while worn in order to hide it from sight.
Alteration Guidelines
This item has not been locked to a final wear location and therefore may not be altered.
You may FLIP the bloodstone pendant to change its worn location until it is worn the first time.
Eligible locations include neck, wrist, ankle, finger, ear/ears, belt, hair, and pin-worn.
The bloodstone pendant will cost 1,750,000 coins.

The gossamer thread constantly unravels and reforms in a mesmerizing dance.  Though entirely insubstantial, the otherworldly strand somehow retains its shape as its essence ripples with a strange, innate responsiveness.
It is currently tier 1.  The maximum tier is 5.  It is empowered by 1 thread.
The vissi can not be worn.
It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of organic material, an extremely common material.
Analysis of a Wealth vissi indicates the creator has provided the following information:

The Wealth vissi can be added to a vissi artifact in order to augment the artifact with custom abilities.  Each vissi artifact may hold up to 5 different types of vissi, and each vissi may be upgradable by adding additional vissi of the same type to the artifact.
The Wealth vissi is named Wealth and it is a Primal vissi.
This vissi notes the following ability information:

This is a primal vissi that is able to either launch a brutal AOE attack or help defend against physical attacks and boost your HP.  Both options equip you with temporary Magma Flares.  The ability (or abilities) have cooldowns.  They have a 120 second cooldown.

The vissi may have abilities you can activate by using certain verbs (RUB, TAP, PUSH, PULL, or POKE) on the vissi artifact you add them to.  In order to set the activator, use ATTEND on the vissi.  The vissi might not have an ability you may activate, in which case ATTEND will indicate that.

Sometimes, a vissi may have multiple abilities you can activate with the activator verbs.  You can TILT the vissi to switch between them.  Tilt will not respond if the vissi has only a single ability (or no abilities at all).  You may only have one ability active at a time.

In addition, the vissi may have abilities with customizable messaging options.  You can TURN the vissi to customize each set of options.  Once on a set of options, you can TWIST the vissi to cycle through the available customizations.
Finally, some vissi may contain ambient messaging, which you can toggle on or off with COVER.
It is currently tier 1.  The maximum tier is 5.  It is empowered by 1 thread.
The Wealth vissi will cost 16,000,000 coins.

This is a tier 3 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.
Attunement:                       Not Attuned
Charges:                          200
Deity:                            Eonak
Deity Primary Color:              Pale golden
Deity Secondary Color:            Brown
Rally [PRAY]:                     Ready
Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH]:       Ready

If the standard's deity conversion ability is not on cooldown, you may visit a shrine honoring a specific deity to convert the standard to that deity.  To do so, simply PRAY standard TO <deity>.  This ability is subject to a 30 day cooldown, and the cooldown is not currently active.

Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.

-- Animalistic Totem --
This fetish is an item that holds the spiritual essence of an animal.  The essence can be gained from animal-like creatures, familiars, animal companions, or Animalistic Spirit items.
==Features==

POINT the fetish at an appropriate animal-like creature, familiar, animal companion, or Animalistic Spirit item to have the fetish absorb some of the creature's essence.

While you are wearing the fetish, the spiritual essence currently chosen will make itself known every so often with ambient messaging.  You can use PROD to quiet the spirit at any time.

You can PUSH Foraged Items, feathers, bones/teeth, skins, and other small items into the fetish and change its long description (the portion after the noun only).  Visit any willing merchant to change how each decoration type looks.  You can then PULL the fetish to remove the item at any time.

While holding something made of metal, wood, or bone in one hand, you can ADD to the fetish to change its base material.  CLEAN it to return it to how it looked initially.  WARNING: Materials used to change the fetish's base material are lost forever, so be sure you are happy with what you choose.
* Accent Material Change [Unlocked]

Once unlocked, you can then TWIST the fetish to focus on the accent material instead of the base material, allowing ADD to change the fetish's article.  You can use CLEAN, as well, while focused on the accent material to return the fetish to its original article.
Once an accent material has been added, you can use FLIP to adjust the article to different styles based on that material.

Ta'Vaalor,.name: a sacrosanct black battle standard with a rippling purple sheen

raw: A faint purple sheen ripples along the standard's fabric at measured intervals, a counterpoint to the pulsing gleam of the runes scribed along the full length of the pole.
You determine that you could wear a sacrosanct black battle standard with a rippling purple sheen as a battle standard.
Analysis of a sacrosanct black battle standard with a rippling purple sheen indicates the creator has provided the following information:
This is a tier 1 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.
Attunement:                       Not Attuned
Charges:                          200
Deity:                            Laethe
Deity Primary Color:              Black
Deity Secondary Color:            Purple
Rally [PRAY]:                     Ready

If the standard's deity conversion ability is not on cooldown, you may visit a shrine honoring a specific deity to convert the standard to that deity.  To do so, simply PRAY standard TO <deity>.  This ability is subject to a 30 day cooldown, and the cooldown is not currently active.
The battle standard can be TUCKed while worn in order to hide it from sight.

This is a flag on a pole, and the description should not conflict with that.  Base, long, and show description can be altered.  Because of the holy and magical nature of this item, the description may include the following words: holy, sacred, consecrated, sacrosanct, and hallowed.

There will always be a reference to the pole and the banner upon LOOKing at this item.  Please take this into account when composing your show description.  The material may be changed to other types of wood at the merchant's discretion.  Allowed nouns: standard, flag, banner, ensign, pennant, pennon, banderole, banderol, bannerol, oriflamme, and gonfalon.  Finally, any and all alterations will be irreversibly removed if the battle standard is ever converted to another deity in the future.
The battle standard may not be lightened.
The battle standard will cost 1,700,000 coins.

Analysis of a fur-trimmed fel totem adorned with a flame-scarred dreadsteed skull indicates the creator has provided the following information:
-- Animalistic Totem --
This totem is an item that holds the spiritual essence of an animal.  The essence can be gained from animal-like creatures, familiars, animal companions, or Animalistic Spirit items.
==Features==
* Spiritual Essences [1 out of 5 Slots Unlocked]
POINT the totem at an appropriate animal-like creature, familiar, animal companion, or Animalistic Spirit item to have the totem absorb some of the creature's essence.
If you have more than one spiritual essence slot unlocked, you can use TURN on the totem to switch between the stored essences.
* Ambient Messages [ON - PROD to toggle]
While you are wearing the totem, the spiritual essence currently chosen will make itself known every so often with ambient messaging.  You can use PROD to quiet the spirit at any time.
* Animalistic Decoration

You can PUSH Foraged Items, feathers, bones/teeth, skins, and other small items into the totem and change its long description (the portion after the noun only).  Visit any willing merchant to change how each decoration type looks.  You can then PULL the totem to remove the item at any time.

While holding something made of metal, wood, or bone in one hand, you can ADD to the totem to change its base material.  CLEAN it to return it to how it looked initially.  WARNING: Materials used to change the totem's base material are lost forever, so be sure you are happy with what you choose.
* Accent Material Change [Locked]

Once unlocked, you can then TWIST the totem to focus on the accent material instead of the base material, allowing ADD to change the totem's article.  You can use CLEAN, as well, while focused on the accent material to return the totem to its original article.
Once an accent material has been added, you can use FLIP to adjust the article to different styles based on that material.
* Movement Styles [Locked]
When unlocked, you can allow the spiritual essence inside the totem to affect how you look when you move from room to room.  SPIN will select a style, while COVER will toggle the feature off.
* Wear Location Change [Unlocked]
When unlocked, you can use FOLD on the totem to switch between pin, wrist, and neck-worn locations.
* Bestial Power [Unlocked - T5 of 5,] Shifting Strike.]  (Flares: ON, RUB to toggle)
When unlocked, the spiritual essence inside the totem can help you passively in combat.  Only one of four paths can be chosen, and this cannot be changed once unlocked.
Abilities happen at a standard flare rate during combat if there are enough charges available.
Animalistic Endurance (Defensive) - +2 crit padding per tier.
Bestial Block (Defensive) - +3 DS/+2 TD per tier
Shifting Strike (Offensive) - +3 AS/+2 CS per tier
Feral Ferocity (Offensive) - +2 crit weighting per tier
The ability is fueled by skins from creatures, and up to 500 charges can be stored.
* Fluff Actions [Unlocked, T2 of 2.]
==Alteration Guidelines==
* Alterations are fine, though the noun must be "idol", "totem", or "fetish".
* The adjective field should contain the material the totem is made of.
* This totem cannot accept a show description.

* Any willing merchant can change the designs for when feathers, bone/teeth, flowers, gems, bugs/sea creatures, or miscellaneous items are PUSHed into the totem.  These work much like Veolas, but the only part of the description you can customize is the part after the noun.
* Any willing merchant can change the color of the different spiritual essences.
==Usage==

You will find that you can use the following verbs: POINT (attune to a creature), ADD (add a material), PUSH (add a decoration), PULL (remove a current decoration), CLEAN (set material back to default), PROD (toggle ambient messages), FOLD (change wear location), PRAY, WAVE (targeted/untargeted), TOUCH, POKE, DROP/PUT (feed skins), RUB (toggle flares on/off).
You can TOSS the totem at a creature/object to send it in for review as a possible spiritual essence source.

River's Rest.name: a sacrosanct grey battle standard with a rippling silver sheen

raw: A faint silver sheen ripples along the standard's fabric at measured intervals, a counterpoint to the pulsing gleam of the runes scribed along the full length of the pole.
You determine that you could wear a sacrosanct grey battle standard with a rippling silver sheen as a battle standard.
Analysis of a sacrosanct grey battle standard with a rippling silver sheen indicates the creator has provided the following information:
This is a tier 6 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.
Attunement:                       Not Attuned
Charges:                          200
Deity:                            'Other'
Deity Primary Color:              Grey
Deity Secondary Color:            Silver
Rally [PRAY]:                     Ready
Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH]:       Ready
Ardent Plea [RAISE]:              Ready
Final Stand [BESEECH]:            Ready

If the standard's deity conversion ability is not on cooldown, you may visit a shrine honoring a specific deity to convert the standard to that deity.  To do so, simply PRAY standard TO <deity>.  This ability is subject to a 30 day cooldown, and the cooldown is not currently active.
The battle standard can be TUCKed while worn in order to hide it from sight.

This is a flag on a pole, and the description should not conflict with that.  Base, long, and show description can be altered.  Because of the holy and magical nature of this item, the description may include the following words: holy, sacred, consecrated, sacrosanct, and hallowed.

There will always be a reference to the pole and the banner upon LOOKing at this item.  Please take this into account when composing your show description.  The material may be changed to other types of wood at the merchant's discretion.  Allowed nouns: standard, flag, banner, ensign, pennant, pennon, banderole, banderol, bannerol, oriflamme, and gonfalon.  Finally, any and all alterations will be irreversibly removed if the battle standard is ever converted to another deity in the future.

It is a passive defense item that has a chance to block an incoming blow.  The chance increases with each tier that is unlocked. When the brooch reaches 10 charges, it automatically flares and absorbs all of the charges.

Bangle Data: (Bangle is absent) An etched bone bangle can be changed by using TURN to remove the bangle and TWIST to add a new one.  Please note, only specialized bangles will work. Additionally, bangles can have special unlocks to change the flare type.

You may alter an ahmdir blue yierka wool cape freely providing it does not contradict the messaging.  The cape can never be a jacket, a longcoat, a coat, a robe, or any similar nouns based on its design.  Nor will it ever have a hood.  This garment will attach at the left wrist by a bangle, slide over the arm and across the left shoulder. Analysis of a Wisdom vissi indicates the creator has provided the following information:

The Wisdom vissi can be added to a vissi artifact in order to augment the artifact with custom abilities.  Each vissi artifact may hold up to 5 different types of vissi, and each vissi may be upgradable by adding additional vissi of the same type to the artifact.
The Wisdom vissi is named Wisdom and it is a Primal vissi.
This vissi notes the following ability information:
Bestows wisdom to the wielder, making
adventures echo powerfully, granting bonus
experience.

The vissi may have abilities you can activate by using certain verbs (RUB, TAP, PUSH, PULL, or POKE) on the vissi artifact you add them to.  In order to set the activator, use ATTEND on the vissi.  The vissi might not have an ability you may activate, in which case ATTEND will indicate that.

Sometimes, a vissi may have multiple abilities you can activate with the activator verbs.  You can TILT the vissi to switch between them.  Tilt will not respond if the vissi has only a single ability (or no abilities at all).  You may only have one ability active at a time.

In addition, the vissi may have abilities with customizable messaging options.  You can TURN the vissi to customize each set of options.  Once on a set of options, you can TWIST the vissi to cycle through the available customizations.
Finally, some vissi may contain ambient messaging, which you can toggle on or off with COVER.
It is currently tier 1.  The maximum tier is 6.  It is empowered by 1 thread.
The Wisdom vissi will cost 30,000,000 coins.

Looking over the yoke and inspecting its finer details, you realize that it will always need to be "a/n (whatever)/sigil-adorned/baldric or yoke".  This means the item's article CAN be changed.  Only "baldric" and "yoke" are valid as nouns, and the adjective of "sigil-adorned" is unalterable.  Also, the allowed wear-locations are shoulder-worn for baldrics and front-worn for yokes.  So if your alteration involves changing the noun, realize the wear-location MUST BE changed also.

NOTE-1:  The script's description of the yoke refers to it as "Constructed of layers of (color) (material)..." and bearing "...rows of faceted sigils...," so keep that in mind if you request an alteration. The color that the charged sigils glow CAN be changed.  It must be no longer than fifteen characters.

This is a Tier 1 yoke, with four tiers in total.  This yoke is sold OTS with one tier unlocked.

This item allows you to transfer its appearance onto another compatible worn item by using the TRANSFER verb.  Hold this item in one hand and the target item in your other.  You must repeat the command within 30 seconds to confirm.
Rules:
- Both items must be worn in the same location
- Both items must either be containers or both be non-containers
- If this item is a container, it must be empty before transfer
- The source item is destroyed after a successful transfer
- If the target item has a script, it must be one approved for transmogrification
You may also use CLEAN to remove this script from the item, or use DUST to remove its long description, turning it into an opulent rolaren necklet.
The rolaren necklet will cost 25,000 coins.
